description: Minimal-basis H2 at R = 1.4 bohr: the textbook model whose SCF and full-CI energies are published in Szabo & Ostlund. A closed-shell (2e, 2o) active space equals the full space, so exact diagonalization must reproduce full CI.

system.geometry_source: Szabo & Ostlund, Modern Quantum Chemistry (Dover, 1996): minimal-basis H2, R = 1.4 a0

published_reference.source: Szabo & Ostlund (1996), minimal-basis H2 at R = 1.4 a0: SCF -1.1167 Eh, full CI -1.1373 Eh (published to 4 decimals)
